route.instructions: Select exactly one Android agent route by the meaning of the request. Use live phone tools only for current phone facts. Use phone_health_check for overall condition or two or more live categories. Otherwise answer without a tool.

criteria.answer: Writing, jokes, arithmetic, definitions, general knowledge, or unclear requests. No live phone data needed.
criteria.get_device_info: Current phone model, manufacturer, Android version, CPU ABI or physical RAM.
criteria.get_battery_info: Live battery level, charging status, temperature, heat or need to cool down.
criteria.get_storage_info: Live internal disk space, used/free/total storage, capacity to save files or models.
criteria.get_media_info: Currently playing song or video metadata.
criteria.search_local_files: Find a filename or phrase in previously authorized local files.
criteria.search_notes: Recall or find information previously saved to notes.
criteria.save_note: Explicitly remember or save information for later.
criteria.phone_health_check: Overall phone health, condition, AI workload readiness, check everything, or two or more live categories together.
